title: Staging P1 governed local-connector encrypted backup executor core

phases.objective: Add offline-tested fail-closed, owner-signed local connector AES-GCM backup core without activating policies, touching database instances, or granting QA/Production authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Signed lease and local destination, with synthetic SQL stream
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Encrypted synthetic artifact, readback SHA, independent key custody and verified signature, with no real Staging backup or QA authority asserted.
steps: Reject missing, revoked or expired apply approval, forged Ed25519 lease and Production source identities.
Bind active allowlisted Staging policy and Local Connector device to one approved local destination.
Stream synthetic SQL through GZIP and AES-256-GCM without a plaintext file.
Verify encrypted artifact SHA-256 and signed manifest; reject injected failures and clean up.
assertions: QA identity writes and Production promotion remain false.
Unsigned policy changes cannot turn a synthetic export into live Staging certification.
No plaintext SQL or recovery AES key is placed in the artifact destination.
Rejected jobs are fail-closed and temporary fragments are removed.
